title: Turkish-Style Daikon Kazandibi
description: A comforting, gluten-free dessert inspired by Turkish cuisine, featuring daikon and kazandibi. This unique dessert combines the sweetness of kazandibi with the crunch of daikon.

ingredients.name: kazandibi
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern grocery stores

instructions: 1. In a medium saucepan, combine 2 cups of water and 1 cup of sugar. Heat over medium heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
2. Add the grated daikon to the saucepan and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the daikon is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
3. Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the lemon juice and vanilla extract, if using.
4. In a separate saucepan, combine the kazandibi and 1 cup of water. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the kazandibi has melted and the mixture is smooth.
5. Add the cooked daikon mixture to the kazandibi mixture and stir until well combined.
6. Pour the mixture into individual serving cups and refrigerate until chilled, at least 2 hours.
7. Serve the Turkish-Style Daikon Kazandibi chilled, garnished with additional lemon juice and sugar, if desired.
